items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: We got a job with our high, Kaifer, Freddie Coleman, Wilbur Burkard...

ctx.x: He's in Gretman. Yeah, he's a pretty good trumpet player. He left me with Detroit. Well, he used to get a group together, like when you get a job. We didn't have a real organized band. We got a job with our high, Kaifer, Freddie Coleman, Wilbur Burkard, and maybe get somebody else from the other side, you know.
Was he any kind to Willie Kaifer? Did you ever know Willie Kaifer? I don't know Willie Kaifer. He was a musician? Yeah. He was a trumpet player and Henry Rush was telling me about him.
Yeah, well that's another guy. Yeah. And I worked with Henry Rush with Kit Thomas. Oh yeah? Yeah.
